Current

St Barts has just finished competing in the 25-26 FTC season.Check out how we did here.

At the moment, we've just finished the 25-26 FTC season. And even though we finished 4th, we are still proud of our accomplishments. We have already started planning for the next season.

Currently, we've just started working on our new robot for the 26-27 FTC season. First of all, we rebuilt our robot autonomy & movement code which will help us perform better in the upcoming competitions.

We've also stripped our robot down to the bones and started to remake our rig to improve its performance and efficiency.

Previous

St Barts Competed in the FIRST Tech Challence in 25-26, and 24-25. Above is a picture of our robot from 24-25.

This year, we competed in the 25-26 FTC season and finished 4th. We are proud of our accomplishments and are already planning for the next season. We were happy that we climbed 5 places compared to last year, but we also are even more determined to win the INSPIRE award, which we were runner up to win last year.

Last year, we finished in 9th place, and we won the Control award, recognising our determination and hard work during the season.

About

Welcome to the RoBarts FIRST Tech Challenge team for St. Bartholomew's School in Newbury!

We are a group of passionate students who are dedicated to designing, building, and programming robots to compete in the FIRST Tech Challenge. Our team is made up of students from various backgrounds and skill levels, but we all share a common goal of learning and growing together through robotics.

Our team is committed to fostering a positive and inclusive environment where everyone can contribute their unique skills and ideas. We believe that teamwork, creativity, and perseverance are key to success in robotics, and we strive to embody these values in everything we do.

We are excited to share our journey with you and hope to inspire others to get involved in robotics and STEM education. Thank you for visiting our website!
